maker: Shenzhen Legend Robot Technology Co., Ltd.
variant: Putty & Latex Paint Spraying Robot, 3.3 m
name: Legend Robot LQ00C
summary: Wheeled interior finishing robot with a lifting mast and a six-axis arm that sprays putty and latex paint airless onto walls and ceilings up to 3.3 m, spraying while it moves. Made by Legend Robot in Shenzhen; used on public-housing refurbishment in Singapore.

germany.statusNote: No German or EU seller found; enquiries go to the maker in Shenzhen. Legend Robot says its robots meet EU CE standards and that it previewed its latex paint and putty spraying robot at BATIMAT 2026 in Paris with a 'European partner ROBOSWISS AG' after a hotel renovation in Athens, but no European sales page was found and the partner's website could not be read.

specs.label: Putty output per day
specs.quote: Daily productivity reaches 500–600 m² for the first coat and 800–1,000 m² for the second coat

specs.label: Putty coat thickness
specs.quote: The first coat of putty is sprayed at a thickness of 1.2–1.5 mm, and the second coat at 0.6–0.9 mm.

specs.label: Footprint
specs.conditions: minimum passage width 840 mm in automatic spraying mode
specs.quote: measuring under 800mm in both length and width

specs.label: Battery
specs.value: 48 V, 105 Ah; 4 h + 4 h with 2 batteries

specs.label: Crew
specs.value: 1 robot + 2 operators for putty; 1 operator for 3 robots for latex paint
specs.conditions: one operator runs the robot, one scrapes and finishes the putty
specs.quote: One robot works with two operators

notes: Omnidirectional chassis with zero turning radius, lifting mechanism and 6-DOF arm; fits through apartment doors, corridors and lifts (maker). Drive described as a chassis; wheels assumed.
Sprays while moving ('mobile spraying') or from fixed points; airless; LiDAR obstacle avoidance and rubber crash strips.
Comes with a dedicated putty mixer (60 L in 5 minutes, enough for two robots) and three-stage filtration.
Putty here is wall skim coating on concrete, drywall or plaster walls, not drywall joint finishing.
